name: Abunai Koi no Sousashitsu ~Eternal Happiness~
original_name: アブナイ恋の捜査室 ~Eternal Happiness~
source:
The investigation division was the same as usual. There, they receive a special request from the top management. The request was as follows: “A princess from a foreign country will be arriving in Japan, so escort the princess as an SP.” However, that princess was an outrageous woman…

Meanwhile, they were to also be in charge of a peculiar fraud case, in which the proprietor and management staff of a famous company are being targeted. As the division solves the case, they gradually become able to see more and more of the truth behind it.

Outside of work, Sakurai Tsubasa has become so close to her boyfriend that they’re thinking of getting married, but her father- stubborn as usual- will not approve.

What is the true objective of the princess’ coming to Japan?

Also, will Tsubasa be able to peacefully receive her father’s approval to get married?

[Translation of the official website's story summary.]
translation:
调查部门和平常一样。在那里，他们收到了高层管理人员的特殊要求。请求内容是：“外国公主即将抵达日本，请以SP的身份护送公主。”然而，那个公主却是个令人发指的女人……

与此同时，他们还负责处理一起特殊的欺诈案件，该案件的目标是一家著名公司的所有者和管理人员。随着案件侦破，他们逐渐看清了案件背后的真相。

工作之余，樱井翼与男友的关系变得如此亲密，以至于他们正在考虑结婚，但她的父亲一如既往地固执，不会批准。

公主来日本的真正目的是什么？

还有，小翼能否平静地得到父亲的同意结婚呢？

【官网故事概要翻译。】
